Market tablet: caption on the department tab for room fittings (walls, lights, furniture). Same tab as hud.shop.tab.restock, ~10 characters.

strings.text: STILL IN THE SHAKER — POUR IT INTO A GLASS
strings.note: Red toast under the top bar when the player backs out of the bench with a drink still in the shaker (it has not been poured into a glass yet). Capitals, display face 14, one line, ~44 characters.

strings.text:
THE BAR IS CLOSED
three days losing money — NEW RUN to try again
strings.note: No longer drawn on screen (2026-09-28): a lost bar ends on the game over's report and the landlord's notice. Line 1 (before the \n) is still read, as the name of the Steam timeline marker where the bar went under - capitals, short. Line 2 is unused; keep the \n.
Top bar, left: small caption over the night number in the day well (the number is drawn under it). 8px body face, centred; the column is 44 units at least and grows with the word, ~7 characters.
Top bar: title row of the hover card over the day well (clock mark on its left). Capitals, 8px face, one line, short.

Top bar: second row of the hover card over the day well. {day} = the run's day number, {week} = the week number, {night} = tonight's name in capitals (calendar.night.*, e.g. FRIDAY). Keep the two spaces either side of each dot. The card grows to fit, one line, ~36 characters.

The between-nights curtain's night sign: the word before the week number, the sign's foot, sitting in the break of its bottom neon tube. 16px body face, one line; the tube is bent round it, so length only widens the break (room ~90 units, ~7 characters).

Story plate (bottom of the room, the last customer's face and words on the left): caption on the small dark key that turns their request down for tonight. Key is 150x32, 8px body face, ~18 characters.
Market tile state row (small word beside a van icon, bottom of the card): this item was ordered tonight and arrives tomorrow. Capitals, 16px row on a ~150-unit card, ~12 characters.
Market tile state row (beside a return-arrow icon): the item can be returned for its money. Capitals, same row as hud.tile.state.on_the_van, ~12 characters.
Market tile state row (beside a padlock icon): the room has no spot this fitting can stand in. Capitals, same row as hud.tile.state.on_the_van, ~12 characters.
Market tile state row (beside a stock icon): this bottle is already full behind the bar, nothing to buy. Capitals, same row as hud.tile.state.on_the_van, ~12 characters.

The word for tonight's drinks rating (the hearts): beside the heart strip on the card that hangs under the top bar's five stars while the pointer is on them (2026-09-28), and on buff rows in the market, the ladder and the book where a fitting or a page raises it. Capitals, 8px body face, one word, ~10 characters.

The word for the room's rating (the medallions: walls, light, furniture): beside the medallion strip on the card that hangs under the top bar's five stars while the pointer is on them (2026-09-28), and on buff rows in the market, the ladder and the book where a fitting raises it. Capitals, 8px body face, one word, ~10 characters.

Title row of the hover card under the top bar's five stars (a star on its left): the bar's standing. The card's second row reads tonight's service and comfort and its two icon strips follow. Capitals, display face, ONE short word or two, ~16 characters at most.

strings.text:
STANDING - A STEP A NIGHT TOWARD THE LOWER OF
SERVICE AND COMFORT
strings.note: Hover card over the top bar's five stars (the bar's standing). ONE sentence set over the card's two rows: the part before the \n is the title row, the part after it the second row; keep exactly one \n. Meaning: each night the stars move one step toward whichever of the two ratings (service, comfort) is lower. When a run is going, the title row stays and the second row is replaced by build.standing.tip_reading, so the title must still read well followed by that formula. Capitals; the card grows to fit, ~46 characters a row.

Second row of the hover card over the top bar's stars while a run is going, under the title row of build.standing.tip. {service} = tonight's drinks rating with one decimal (e.g. 3.0); {comfort} = the room over the night so far - the figure the night files - with two decimals (e.g. 2.54); {tonight} = the lower of the two, what tonight is filed at, with one decimal. Keep the spacing around · and =. Capitals, one line, ~46 characters.
Not shown any more (2026-09-28): the top bar's cog key is gone. Kept so the tables stay whole; it needs no revision.

RETIRED 2026-09-28: no longer drawn. The moment in the dark before the day-end receipt prints shows a drawn CLOSED neon sign now (signage, the same in every language). Kept so older builds still find it; no need to translate.
Grey line under the drawn CLOSED neon sign in the dark at closing time, before the day-end receipt prints. Lower case on purpose; 16px body face, one line, ~34 characters.
Printed heading at the top of the night's till receipt (the paper slip at day end); the date line sits under it. Display face 24 on a ~396-unit paper, one line, ~16 characters.
Caption on the full-width amber key at the foot of the till receipt, before the screen sets its real caption (dayend.bill.next). Display face 16 on a 456x44 key, one line, ~20 characters.

Market tablet title bar, right: small label over the money readout (the till's balance) in the dark sunken box. 8px body face, 80-unit box, ~10 characters.

Market basket head band (dark strip at the page foot): small label left of what the basket's order costs. 8px shop face, right-aligned in a 60-unit box, ~7 characters. Look test compares this band pixel for pixel in English.

Market basket head band: small label left of the money the till will have after the order. 8px shop face, right-aligned in a 130-unit box, ~16 characters. Look test compares this band pixel for pixel in English.

strings.text: {money} to spend at the market and on the room.
strings.note: First row of the till's hover card, the card that hangs under the green money figure at the top right of the top bar while the pointer is on it (tonight's bill and the red nights follow it: hud.till.tip_*). {money} is the till's money with its sign, e.g. "$2520" or "-$40". Sentence case, 8px body face, one line of ~48 characters.

strings.text: Tonight's bill, taken at close: ${bill} (rent + walk-outs - thanks)
strings.note: Top bar: a row of the till's hover card, the card that hangs under the green money figure at the top right while the pointer is on it; shown only while the bar is open. {bill} = what the close will take out of the till tonight (tonight's rent, plus the fees owed for guests who walked out, less the landlord's thanks for right kicks), whole dollars, digits only, after the $. Sentence case, 8px body face, one line; the card grows to fit, ~70 characters.

strings.text: Red nights in a row: {strikes} of {limit}
strings.note: Top bar: a row of the till's hover card (under the green money figure). {strikes} = how many nights in a row have closed with the till under $0 so far, {limit} = how many shut the bar for good (3); digits. 'Red night' is the game's word for such a night - hud.till.tip_red_rule defines it on the next row, so translate it the same way in both. Sentence case, 8px body face, one line, ~42 characters.

strings.text: A red night closes with the till under $0; {limit} in a row shut the bar.
strings.note: Top bar: the row under hud.till.tip_red on the till's hover card: what a red night is. {limit} = how many red nights in a row close the bar for good (always 3, digits). Keep 'red night' as in hud.till.tip_red. Sentence case, 8px body face, one line; the card grows to fit, ~72 characters.

strings.text: Closing now would make it {next} of {limit}: the bill is bigger than the till.
strings.note: Top bar: a red warning row at the foot of the till's hover card, shown only while tonight's bill is bigger than the money in the till (the close would leave it under $0). {next} = the red night in a row this close would be, {limit} = how many shut the bar (3); digits. Sentence case, 8px body face, one line; the card grows to fit, ~78 characters.
Title row of the till's hover card over the green money figure on the top bar (the money mark on its left). Capitals, 8px display face, one short line.
